subject: DVRL kickoff - data valuation as a product surface
body:
Team,

Kicking off the DVRL productization effort today. The pitch: our open-source DVRL release scores individual training examples with a reinforcement-learned data value estimator, and customers keep asking us which 10% of their data is hurting their models. We ship that answer.

Scope for this half covers three of the four applications in the codebase: data valuation, corrupted sample discovery with robust learning on tabular data, and domain adaptation. The image transfer-learning variant is a stretch goal.

Rough milestones: internal demo on a customer-shaped tabular dataset by June 8, Launch Review Board pre-read by July 6, decision on external pilot by end of window (Aug 3). Deshawn will follow up on staffing and compute; Wei owns the modeling track.

OKR framing for Q2: "identify 80%+ of injected corrupted labels at 20% noise on two tabular benchmarks." We beat that in the paper setting, now we need it repeatable.

Thanks,
Lucia
